cohort: The study included medical records of 452 patients who were treated for obstetric fistula at the National Obstetric Fistula Centre, Abakaliki, between January 2014 and May 2018.
finding: Antenatal care, duration of labor, mode of delivery, and circumferential fistula were identified as significant determinants of obstetric palsy among patients with obstetric fistula.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery was a significant determinant of obstetric palsy among patients with obstetric fistula.
